name: claude-remote-panel
description: Claude Remote — painel do dev-box (React + Tailwind + xterm.js + CodeMirror, servido pelo server.js com terminal via WebSocket/PTY, SSE, 2FA)

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('server')) { require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'server/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' }) }" && node -e "require('./server/config.js'); require('./server/totp.js'); require('./server/usage.js'); require('./server/limits.js'); require('./server/logs.js')"
